about_the_game:
Dungeon Runnerz is an all-out deck-building roguelike dungeon-crawler where you prepare your champion with equipment, items and spells by buying booster packs and equipment, item and spell cards before sending them on a perilous journey through the Emporer's labyrinth. Unlock new cards, items and spells by completing dungeon runs and gain more followers, magical items and enchanted weapons to take on even more dangerous foes!

Build Your Deck!

Collect items, spells and equipment by buying booster packs and discovering the possibilities of the cards within. Cards can be equipped to your character before entering battle and come with a huge variety of abilities from stat-boosting weapons to health-boosting potions, from enchanted shields built to boost your armor class to one-off spells that shatter the enemy’s weapons or decimate them completely.

Play Your Cards Right

When the battle begins, you’ll need to sift through your deck and play the right cards at the right time. Fighter needs an enery-boost? Drag ‘n’ drop your energy-boosting spell card onto the playing portal and watch it take affect. You have limited control over your warrior once battle begins, and they’ll be relying on your quick thinking skills to play the correct cards to help them explore the dungeon and conquer their foes.

Conquer!

If you’ve planned ahead properly, you’ll make your way through the 10 stages of procedurally-generated dungeon, annihilating a variety of monstrous creates and overcoming challenges while collecting delicious loot to use for your next run. Death is always around the corner (and to be expected), but please the Emporer with your quick-thinking and planning, and you’ll become the champion of the realm!

short_description: Dungeon Runnerz is a roguelike deck-building dungeon-crawler where you battle your way through enemies and arenas to be crowned champion of the realm. Build your deck, equip your hero and dive into the chaos of battle as carve your way through swathes of enemies and procedural dungeons.
